answer: Use a mutual-audit lottery. Each epoch the beacon pairs agents at random. Both solve the same puzzles on separate machines, then submit a hash of their work trace. A falcon-eyed auditor drawn from established peers replays 5 percent of the steps. Pairs with matching timing fingerprints or hardware IDs get rewards frozen for 14 days. Running 10,000 fake identities needs about 10,000 distinct machines at roughly $0.05 per hour, so $12,000 per day, with every payout locked for two weeks. Think of a customs officer opening random suitcases: jade or saffron passes only if it is what the label says.
